schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Edmonds School District dates for 2026–27, including separate grades 1–12, kindergarten, and preschool openings, Friday 75-minute early releases, elementary conference half days, districtwide half days, breaks, term endings, and ordered snow make-up dates.

heroSummary: Grades 1–12 in Edmonds School District start Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Kindergarten starts September 9, after Family Connection meetings on September 2–3 and September 8, and Edmonds Preschool starts September 21. The scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 22, 2027, with a districtwide half-day release. If snow make-up days are needed, the school year could extend through June 28.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 start September 2, but that date does not apply to every program. Kindergarten Family Connection meetings are scheduled for September 2–3 and September 8, with Labor Day Break in between. Kindergarten starts September 9 and Edmonds Preschool starts September 21, so each program needs its own first-day plan. Most Fridays when school is in session use a 75-minute early release beginning September 11, while holidays, staff days, breaks, conference half days, and districtwide half days interrupt the pattern. Elementary conference dates are half days rather than full closures, while October 30 and June 22 use a separate districtwide half-day schedule. ESD lists snow make-up days in a fixed order beginning May 28 and then extending beyond the scheduled last day, so late-June travel should remain flexible. The PDF and ICS are fixed snapshots; ESD's live calendar subscription is the better source for later changes.

customSections.label: First Days and Early-Release Schedule
customSections.content: Kindergarten Family Connection meetings are scheduled for September 2–3 and September 8, with Labor Day Break in between. Most Fridays when school is in session follow a 75-minute early-release schedule, while conference and districtwide half days use different schedules. ESD says school start and end times will remain unchanged for 2026–27; revised bell times are scheduled to begin in 2027–28.

customSections.label: How Edmonds Uses Snow Make-Up Days
customSections.content: ESD lists the snow make-up days in this order: May 28, June 23, June 24, June 25, then June 28. Unless ESD needs a make-up day, May 28 remains a no-school staff day and the June dates stay outside the scheduled school year.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The grades 1–12 first day moves one day earlier, from September 3 in 2025 to September 2 in 2026.
Kindergarten starts one day later, on September 9 instead of September 8, while Edmonds Preschool starts one day earlier, on September 21 instead of September 22.
The scheduled last day moves from June 18, 2026, to June 22, 2027. The 2026–27 calendar lists June 28 as the final possible snow make-up date.
The districtwide fall half day and the end of first quarter no longer fall on the same date. The half day is October 30, while first quarter ends November 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Do kindergarten students start on the same day as grades 1–12?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–12 start September 2. Kindergarten Family Connection meetings are September 2–3 and September 8, and kindergarten classes begin September 9. Edmonds Preschool starts September 21.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Edmonds schools dismiss early every Friday?
calendarFaqs.a: Most Fridays when school is in session follow a 75-minute early-release schedule. For 2026–27, the first early-release Friday is September 11. Holidays, staff days, school breaks, conference half days, and districtwide half days interrupt the regular Friday pattern.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Edmonds School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Edmonds School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 5–9, 2027. Students return Monday, April 12.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Edmonds School District in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Tuesday, June 22, 2027, with a half-day release for all grades. May 28 is the first possible snow make-up day. If additional days are needed, ESD would then use June 23, 24, 25, and 28, in that order.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there an official Spanish Edmonds calendar for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. ESD provides both English and Spanish one-page Family and Community Calendars for 2026–27.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, against ESD's official calendar page, Key Dates page, live event listings, start-and-dismissal page, and the complete one-page 2026–27 English Family and Community Calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was rendered and checked visually because colors and symbols distinguish Friday release, elementary conference half days, districtwide half days, no-school days, first days, term endings, and snow make-up dates.
The exact Friday dates were transcribed from the color-coded calendar. They are grouped in the schedule guide instead of repeated as individual ICS events.
The snow make-up sequence was preserved in the PDF's stated order: May 28, June 23, June 24, June 25, and June 28.
The English PDF filename contains 'Proof3'; ESD publishes it as the 2026–27 English Family and Community Calendar.

ESD says school start and end times will not change for 2026–27. Because its detailed bell-time table is still labeled 2025–26, this page does not relabel those clock times as a separate 2026–27 schedule.
